params.body: Branch protection ("Require branches to be up to date before merging") is not available for a private repository on this GitHub plan, so the tests workflow gets a job `up-to-date` that fails when the pull request branch is behind `main`. Why: the gateway pushes snapshots; a pull request proposed before a sibling merged can silently revert that sibling in shared files (2026-09-15, PRs 456 vs 457/459), and green checks from before the sibling merged say nothing about the merge result. Red means: rebase and re-propose on the current main. Runs only on pull_request events; no change to the phpunit or assets jobs.
params.title: CI: a pull request behind main is a red X
